messages:
noa: Heads-up from the weekly account health sweep for AcmeCorp — overall usage fine but error rate pronounced in last 90m. 5xx at 2.9% (+1.1ppt), timeouts 1.5% (+0.7ppt), 429s 1.1% (+0.4ppt). Can we surface the top failing endpoints and immediate next steps? :mag:
maria: Pulled top endpoints by error volume (last 2h): /v1/embeddings/batch, /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /analytics/push. Embeddings batch shows a lot of 504s and some 502s. Sample log snippets below.
```
2026-01-19T09:10:05Z ERROR 504 downstream_timeout POST /v1/embeddings/batch job=eb_442 lat=4502ms
2026-01-19T09:11:12Z ERROR 502 bad_gateway POST /v1/chat/stream id=ch_x9 lat=1100ms
2026-01-19T09:12:30Z WARN 429 rate_limit POST /v1/generate user=acct_acme token_bucket=0.0
```
carlos: Noted. There's a client-side change from Acme that started 2 days ago — they switched to larger batch sizes for embeddings (n=512 -> n=2048) and enabled parallel workers. That will pressure our embeddings batch path and downstream model-serving batching.
jess: Acme is in onboarding week 6; finance flagged spend trending higher due to retries. They need a clear mitigation plan before the renewal review next week.
monitor-bot: infra-bot: system note: model-server pool embeddings-pool saw CPU saturations at 09:08Z and queue growth +62% for 15m. No autoscale event triggered (min_instances=2).
maria: Quick repro for embeddings bulk (from our side):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings/batch -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-embed-1","inputs":["... repeated ..."]}'
```
carlos: Immediate mitigations I recommend: 1) throttle max batch size for this customer at the edge to 1024, 2) enable temporary autoscale override for embeddings-pool (+1 instance), 3) disable client retries (coordinate with CSM). Which can ops/infra do now?
noa: Ops can do (2) now — I'll request autoscale override. Edge throttling needs a config push but can be done in ~20m. Disabling retries requires customer coordination; ask CSM.
jess: I'll message Acme CSM right now: ask them to pause increasing parallel workers and to accept temporary throttling. Tell them we're adding capacity and expect error rate to drop in ~15-30m.
maria: Also seeing a smaller but persistent 5xx cluster on /analytics/push — looks like downstream queueing at our ingest worker. Pinging eng-infra to check the queue consumer.
monitor-bot: deploy-bot: no recent deploys to embeddings-pool since 2026-01-16. Autoscale settings unchanged.
carlos: Update: applied autoscale override +1 to embeddings-pool at 09:25Z. Early telemetry: embeddings batch 504s dropped from 3.1% -> 0.9% in 8 minutes. Overall 5xx now 1.8%. Edge throttling scheduled for 09:40Z.
noa: Edge throttling rolled out at 09:42Z for Acme — max batch size set to 1024, per-minute ingestion capped. Monitoring.
jess: CSM update sent: said we'll scale and throttle temporarily; they accepted and paused client-side parallel workers. Expecting lower spend from fewer retries.
maria: After changes: 5xx now 1.2%, timeouts 0.7%, 429s 0.6%. I'll keep the incident ticket open for another 2 hours and then move to monitoring-only. Ticket: INC-20260119-ACME-EMBEDS.
carlos: Follow-ups: propose adding a per-customer batching guide to onboarding docs (recommend default max batch 1024) and add a check in onboarding QA for batch size flags. Creating a short action item doc.
oa: Agreed. Also suggest a small autoscale policy tweak: trigger when queue growth > 30% for 10m for embeddings-pool. I'll file an infra PR.
jess: Thanks everyone. I'll remove the renewal risk flag if metrics remain stable during the 2-hour holding period; otherwise we'll escalate. Posting a short note to Acme in 30m with progress. :white_check_mark:
